definitions.name: bridge_refresh_sessions
definitions.sql:
CREATE TABLE `bridge_refresh_sessions` (
  `id` bigint NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `token_hash` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin NOT NULL,
  `expires_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `revoked_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_used_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `user_agent` varchar(255) DEFAULT NULL,
  `last_ip` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `credential_version` tinyint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '3',
  `installation_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `profile_id` varchar(128) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `generation` int unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '1',
  `migration_key` char(64) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_fingerprint` char(71) CHARACTER SET ascii COLLATE ascii_bin DEFAULT NULL,
  `source_refresh_session_id` bigint DEFAULT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_bridge_refresh_token` (`token_hash`),
  KEY `idx_bridge_refresh_user` (`user_id`,`revoked_at`,`expires_at`),
  KEY `idx_bridge_refresh_expiry` (`expires_at`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=24 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

definitions.name: ai_model_profiles
definitions.sql:
CREATE TABLE `ai_model_profiles` (
  `id` int NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `owner_user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `scope` enum('user','platform') NOT NULL,
  `provider` varchar(64) NOT NULL,
  `model_name` varchar(191) NOT NULL,
  `api_base_url` varchar(512) DEFAULT NULL,
  `api_key_encrypted` text,
  `key_version` varchar(32) DEFAULT NULL,
  `temperature` decimal(3,2) DEFAULT NULL,
  `max_tokens` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `thinking_enabled` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `reasoning_effort` varchar(16) DEFAULT NULL,
  `request_timeout_ms` int unsigned DEFAULT NULL,
  `is_default` tinyint NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `status` varchar(16) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'inactive',
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `updated_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `deleted_at` datetime(3) DEFAULT NULL,
  `active_default_owner_key` int GENERATED ALWAYS AS ((case when ((`is_default` = 1) and (`status` = _utf8mb4'active') and (`deleted_at` is null)) then `owner_user_id` else NULL end)) STORED /*!80023 INVISIBLE */,
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  UNIQUE KEY `uk_model_active_default_owner` (`active_default_owner_key`),
  KEY `idx_model_profiles_owner` (`owner_user_id`,`deleted_at`),
  KEY `idx_model_profiles_scope` (`scope`,`status`,`deleted_at`),
  CONSTRAINT `chk_v4_model_profiles_owner` CHECK ((((`scope` = _utf8mb4'platform') and (`owner_user_id` = 0)) or ((`scope` = _utf8mb4'user') and (`owner_user_id` > 0))))
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=7 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

definitions.name: ai_model_usage_logs
definitions.sql:
CREATE TABLE `ai_model_usage_logs` (
  `id` bigint unsigned NOT NULL AUTO_INCREMENT,
  `user_id` int NOT NULL,
  `model_profile_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `credential_source` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `usage` varchar(32) NOT NULL,
  `request_phase` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `strategy_id` int DEFAULT NULL,
  `token_count` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `request_status` varchar(16) NOT NULL,
  `error_code` varchar(128) DEFAULT NULL,
  `created_at` datetime(3) NOT NULL,
  `request_bytes` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `response_bytes` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `duration_ms` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `input_tokens` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `output_tokens` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `reasoning_tokens` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `cached_tokens` bigint unsigned NOT NULL DEFAULT '0',
  `provider_request_id` varchar(191) DEFAULT NULL,
  `finish_reason` varchar(64) DEFAULT NULL,
  `incomplete_details_json` text,
  `accounting_status` varchar(24) NOT NULL DEFAULT 'usage_unknown',
  PRIMARY KEY (`id`),
  KEY `idx_usage_logs_user` (`user_id`,`created_at`),
  KEY `idx_usage_logs_usage` (`usage`,`created_at`),
  KEY `idx_usage_provider_request` (`provider_request_id`)
) ENGINE=InnoDB AUTO_INCREMENT=12140 DEFAULT CHARSET=utf8mb4 COLLATE=utf8mb4_0900_ai_ci

explains.name: quota
explains.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) requests,COALESCE(SUM(token_count),0) tokens FROM ai_model_usage_logs WHERE user_id=? AND credential_source='platform_shared' AND (request_phase='request' OR request_phase IS NULL) AND created_at>=CURRENT_DATE()

explains.name: recovery
explains.sql: SELECT id FROM ai_model_usage_logs WHERE request_status='reserved' AND created_at<? ORDER BY id LIMIT 100
